profile.name: Venktesh Kumar Gupta
profile.title: Product Manager
profile.tagline: Turning user research and data into products people actually want.
profile.summary: Results-driven Product Management professional with 3 years of experience leveraging user research, product discovery, and data-driven insights to solve business problems and improve customer experiences. Proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, prioritise product requirements, and deliver impactful digital solutions across consulting and product environments.

bullets: Conducted market research, competitive analysis, and technology assessments for 10+ global clients, identifying customer needs and industry trends that informed strategic product decisions and business opportunities.

Partnered with business stakeholders and engineering teams to gather requirements and translate business challenges into scalable technology solutions, driving digital transformation initiatives across multiple client engagements.

Designed and developed Power BI and Tableau dashboards using SQL and Python, enabling real-time KPI tracking that improved reporting efficiency by 40% and enhanced visibility into business performance metrics.

Analysed application usage, operational performance, and customer feedback data to generate actionable insights that influenced product enhancements and process optimisation across multiple engagements.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to improve user adoption of enterprise applications by simplifying workflows and enhancing user experience, delivering training programs that reduced user errors by 40%.

Supported product evaluation and vendor assessment exercises by conducting gap analyses, solution benchmarking, and feasibility assessments to recommend technology investments aligned with business objectives.
Designed and executed A/B tests on pilot features to validate user engagement hypotheses, driving data-backed iterations that improved conversion rates across key user flows.

Developed and managed the end-to-end product roadmap for a pilot program, translating research insights from 160+ stakeholders into a phased execution plan with defined milestones and delivery timelines.
Shaped pilot design by conducting structured primary research with 160+ stakeholders, gathering and validating product requirements that directly informed BRD-aligned feature specifications.

Cut ad-hoc reporting effort by building automated KPI dashboards using Google Analytics and Excel, establishing reusable performance tracking frameworks that reduced leadership reporting time and improved visibility.
Ran sprint planning, backlog prioritisation, and structured risk tracking across an 8-week program, maintaining 100% on-time delivery of all programme outputs across cross-functional teams.
Visualised product requirements and user journeys through User Story Mapping, aligning cross-functional teams on project scope and enabling iterative delivery across multiple sprints.
